method: Hand-curated semantic field layouts grounded in (a) per-byte entropy buckets from inbound_payload_schemas.json, (b) receiver class names from receiver_opcode_map_inbound.json, (c) the standard 1.x receiver convention (actor delta arrives via GameMessage header src/tgt fields, body holds receiver-specific data and zero padding). Field sizes sum exactly to the innerLen of each opcode.

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Bulk actor state sync. 94 bytes of varying state followed by 42 bytes of zero padding.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offsets 0..1: medium+low entropy (21 / 3 unique values across 79 samples); likely a block-id + sub-id tag pair
offsets 2..5: medium entropy (12-13 unique values), 4 of which dominate the corpus (~42% each); pair of u16 IDs or one u32 actor handle
offset 6: high entropy (48 unique values); the highest-variance byte in the body - candidate for an actor or session ID component
offsets 8..93: medium-to-low entropy data block; layout is opaque without receiver-decomp byte-by-byte cross-correlation
offsets 94..135: invariant zero across all 79 samples; reserved padding

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Sets event status on an actor. 1 status byte + 3 pad + ~15 bytes of event metadata + 18 pad + 3 bytes of trailing varying data.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offset 0: low entropy (few discrete status kind values)
offsets 1..3: invariant zero across all 43 samples
offsets 4..18: low entropy data block carrying per-event metadata (event ID, scene ID, conditions)
offsets 19..36: invariant zero across all 43 samples
offset 37: high entropy (48 unique values) - candidate for a trailing selector / index
offsets 38..39: medium entropy; paired with offset 37

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Sub-stat mode + border change. 8-byte compact body: 1 pad + 3 mode bytes + 2 pad + 2 border bytes.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offset 0: invariant zero across all 36 samples
offsets 1..3: low entropy mode bytes (sub-stat mode set)
offsets 4..5: invariant zero across all 36 samples
offsets 6..7: low entropy border values

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Extra-stat delta. 8-byte body: 1 stat-type byte + 7 zero pad. Actor ID arrives via GameMessage header src field.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offset 0: low entropy (small set of stat-kind values)
offsets 1..7: invariant zero across all 30 samples

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Sub-stat status change. 40-byte body is ENTIRELY invariant zero across all 30 samples - the actor delta is conveyed via the GameMessage header (opcode = which sub-stat, src = which actor); the body is reserved padding.

proposedFieldLayout.value: all 40 bytes invariant zero across all 30 samples; receiver's meaningful state is in the GameMessage header, not the body

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Shadow actor flag change. 8-byte body is ENTIRELY invariant zero across all 30 samples - same header-only delta pattern as 0x0179.

proposedFieldLayout.value: all 8 bytes invariant zero across all 30 samples; receiver's meaningful state is in the GameMessage header, not the body

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Set display name. 3 bytes of varying header + 37 bytes of zero padding. The actual name is likely resolved server-side by ID and the body just carries a name-table index or kind selector.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offsets 0..2: medium entropy (likely a 2-3 byte name-table index / kind)
offsets 3..39: invariant zero across all 30 samples
